title: Nightmark #1 Alpha Productions 1994 Independent Horror Comic First Issue
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright; spine and staples intact. A few small white flecks on the black back cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Nightmark #1, Alpha Productions (1994) - first issue of the independent supernatural detective/horror series. $2.25 cover price.

Back cover: "Aren't you dead yet?" Alpha Productions teaser.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
